result.stderr:
Usage: neuralguard --diff=<path> [options]

  --diff=<path>          Unified diff to analyze. Required.
  --backend=<name>       codebert or scratch. Default: codebert.
  --claude-model=<id>    Model that reviews the findings. Default: claude-opus-5.
  --threshold=<0..1>     Confidence that sends a finding to review. Default: 0.6.
  --block=<true|false>   Whether a confirmed vulnerability fails the run. Default: True.
  --output=<path>        Also write the Markdown report to a file.
